name: notification_failure_rate
description: More than 20% of delivery attempts on a channel failed over the last 10 minutes, with at least 20 attempts.

query_condition.promql: (sum by (channel) (increase(notification_delivery{status="FAILED"}[10m])) / sum by (channel) (increase(notification_delivery{status=~"SENT|FAILED"}[10m]))) and on (channel) (sum by (channel) (increase(notification_delivery{status=~"SENT|FAILED"}[10m])) >= 20)
